message: Dispatcher 2.2.7 commit df42beebc1a7a23ec4afd039a9ae612efe86814b is not approved for live install yet. Review: .agent-handoff/review-turn-29.md. Fix these blockers in agent-handoff only: (1) do not classify current ChatGPT /c/WEB:<id> URLs as stale solely by syntax; validate by observable page behavior and let wait_for_conversation_url accept the actual URL form produced by the live UI; (2) make the one-recovery latch atomic across replacement URL save so save_control_url/provision cannot erase recovery_used in a crash window; (3) harden message DOM fallback to cover conversation-turn-* and infer user/assistant role from role attributes/accessible labels, with tests beyond pure decision logic. Preserve no bootstrap spam, CONTROL_RETRY_SECONDS, wake de-duplication, diagnostics without message text. Do not modify main or arena/local-agent-v0. Do not enable Phase 2/live mailbox. Return commit SHA, changed files, exact tests, and recovery semantics.
